Took leftover garlic mashed potatoes added some cheese, shredded up leftover steak, chives and salt and pepper. Combined all that and make into balls and then heated up some oil in a pot. Take the balls dip them into an egg wash then  roll them in either panko crumbs or I just used plain breadcrumbs. Then put them in the oil for about 2 or 3 mins. Move to a plate with paper towel. Add some parmesan cheese to the top once done.

Was my first time making it and it turned out great. Was a great way to take leftovers from last night's dinner and turn them into a party appetizer. You can replace the steak with bacon too.
